_comment: PARTIAL, and the missing half is the important half. 'Cards and abilities cost you an additional {r} to play or activate' is a persistent cost tax on its controller; the DSL has MODIFY_NEXT_CARD_COST, which is a one-shot on the next card, and nothing that raises costs continuously while a permanent is in the arena. NEEDS A NEW PRIMITIVE. The destroy clauses ARE authored, so the token appears and expires correctly; it simply does not tax yet. 'or activate an ability' has no ON_ACTIVATE_ANY trigger either, so only the play half of the second clause fires.
